summary: - **[AIDASoft/podio#1050](https://github.com/AIDASoft/podio/pull/1050)** — ROOTWriter and RNTupleWriter now accept compression settings. A new WriterFor builder makes the high-level Writer interface configurable, so compression and other options can be passed to the underlying writers while the environment-variable switch to RNTuple still works.

- **[AIDASoft/podio#1023](https://github.com/AIDASoft/podio/pull/1023)** — podio can now be built without ROOT through the ENABLE_ROOT option, which reaches downstream projects as the PODIO_ENABLE_ROOT CMake variable and preprocessor define. ROOT remains the default, and all Python interfaces still require it.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#452](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/452)** — Fixes a memory leak in the Writer for collections registered through the old DataHandle or a DataWrapper, as k4SimDelphesAlg does. A Pythia8 + Delphes IDEA job leaked about 1.8 kB per event, roughly 1.7 GB over a long production.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#67](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/67)** — Fixes units across k4Gen. GaussSmearVertex time smearing was about 300 times too small. HepEVTReader and MDIReader production times are now converted to ns. HepMC file readers now convert events to GeV and mm, including the root vertex.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#682](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/682)** — Fixes the IDEA o2 HCAL endcap, whose cell ID metadata was encoded with the barrel encoding in the DRTubes sensitive-detector action, giving wrong endcap cell IDs in simulated output.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1712](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1712)** — Makes DetElement nominal/survey alignment and VolumeManager creation thread-safe, fixing crashes in multi-threaded ddsim with ALLEGRO when segmentations were first initialised concurrently in Geant4 worker threads. (see also **AIDASoft/DD4hep#1713**)

- **[key4hep/k4geo#676](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/676)** — The ALLEGRO turbine ECAL endcap now places each wheel's cells in its own mother volume. Time to first event drops from about 175 s to 104 s (single thread) and peak memory from 9.0 to 7.0 GB in 8-thread Z→qq jobs, with negligible change in per-event time over 10k-event jobs.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#119](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/119)** — GGTFTrackFinder gets a major CPU-time and memory optimization. The LibTorch dependency is removed by rewriting the clustering in plain C++, ONNX Runtime graph optimizations are enabled, and a new InferenceThreads property sets inference threading.

- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#170](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/170)** — Fixes a segfault on the first event in DelphesPythia8EvtGen_EDM4HEP and its k4Interface variant, caused by the Event branch never being created.

- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#165](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/165)** — The EDM4hep output compression of k4SimDelphes is now configurable, with zstd-5 as the new default (requires podio > 1.9). It saves about 13% storage and reads back up to 50% faster at negligible production cost. (see also **key4hep/k4SimDelphes#169**, which makes the --rntuple flag take effect)
